## Description

Separate app and host for the Medvya team: company SSO then a security key (no passwords, no shared accounts), lost-key recovery by a second owner with a one-hour link, roles (owner, operations, support, finance, reviewer), quarterly access review, nav of 16 pages, every action needs a reason and is logged to an append-only platform audit log that can be exported. The console reads only the control plane: tenant catalogue, plan, routing and counts; it never shows patient records (data map and architecture test).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given a Medvya user, when signs in without a security key, then access is refused.
- [ ] **AC2.** Given a platform action, when is taken without a reason, then it is rejected.
- [ ] **AC3.** Given any console endpoint, when returns data, then it holds no patient field (architecture test).
- [ ] **AC4.** Given a key is lost, when another owner verifies on a video call, then a one-hour link is issued, the old key is revoked and both steps are logged.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
